items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The oldest brother was Frank. He passed away.

ctx.x: Do you remember the names of your brothers?

Yes. The oldest brother was Frank. He passed away. The oldest girl was Edie. She passed away. The rest of us are still around. That’s Tony. He’s younger than me. Henry is the baby of the boys. Josephine, Dee Dee, and Mary are the girls left.
You were born in one place in Illinois. Then you moved to Peoria. Then you moved to Moline. Do you have any recollections of Peoria?
